newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent falls as NYMEX weakens after API data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent falls as NYMEX weakens after API data.

text.p: August Brent futures fell on Wednesday in line with the weakness of NYMEX crude futures after overnight API data showed a weaker draw in gasoline that had been expected.
August fell to last trade at $18.29 per barrel, down nine cents from London's close on Tuesday. Volume was just three lots.
But NYMEX August crude was down 14 cents on ACCESS at $19.59, cutting New York's 21-cent gain.
Apart from the weak stock draw, implied gasoline demand fell and crude stocks grew more than had been expected.
August gasoline futures on ACCESS were last traded at 58.50 cents per gallon, down 0.42 from New York where prices had gained 0.98 to 58.92.
